$comment: What the mascot can wear, and where each look comes from.
This file is the hand-authored half; art/index.json is generated from it by
scripts/art-sync.mjs, which measures every image's alpha bounding box and
derives the framing numbers and accent colours the client needs. Adding a look
is therefore: add an entry here, run `npm run fetch-art` (or drop the file in
art/ and run `npm run art:sync`). Nothing in lib/ needs editing.
The artwork itself is NOT in this repository: it is official game art owned by
id/character/name  identity; `character` must match a characters[] entry
file               single static image (mutually exclusive with frames)
frames             list of images the client cross-fades through, for a look
that animates without an animated file format
cutout             run scripts/cutout.mjs on the download. `true` keeps the
largest connected component; `"all"` keeps every sizeable
one (a sheet with two poses); `"second"` keeps the second
urls               tried in order; first non-empty body wins
sha256             pins the bytes of the SOURCE download
